content: The alignment process therefore frequently requires rephrasing the text, for instance, in order to make it more neutral and avoid generating arbitrary subjective judgements. We find that the news article commonly includes description that is not evident from the data (e.g., subjective characteristics of the player or the shot), and often may reflect the reporter's viewpoint. For instance, the reporter may evaluate an event negatively by writing Player A did not manage to score more than one goal, reflecting expectation of the player's performance, which we would change into a more objective form such as Player A scored one goal. Similarly, word choices based on viewing the game (e.g., slapshot) are changed to more neutral counterparts.
